roe.name: Return on equity
roe.equation: core PAT / average equity (share capital + reserves)
roe.meaning: Owners' core profit per rupee of shareholders' equity.

band.rationale: ROE below the cost of equity destroys value; 5pp above it is clear value creation. Ke = rf + beta x ERP (config/market.yaml).

roe.text: Return on equity: 17.7% AMBER (level amber vs band (red <= 15.8%, green >= 20.8%))

roa.name: Return on assets
roa.meaning: Owners' core profit per rupee of total assets.

band.rationale: RBI Report on Trend and Progress of Banking 2024-25: scheduled commercial banks' RoA 1.4% (RoE 13.5%). Amber zone = 1.4% +/- 20%.

roa.text: Return on assets: 1.6% GREEN (level amber vs band (red <= 1.1%, green >= 1.7%))

roe_ke_spread.name: ROE - cost of equity
roe_ke_spread.equation: ROE - Ke, Ke = rf + beta x ERP
roe_ke_spread.meaning: Value created per rupee of equity for a lender/insurer.

band.rationale: Spread below zero = value destruction; above +5pp = clear value creation.

roe_ke_spread.text: ROE - cost of equity: +1.9pp AMBER (level amber vs band (red <= +0.0pp, green >= +5.0pp))

pb_percentile_10y.meaning: Where today's P/B sits within the company's own FY-end history (0% = cheapest ever, 100% = richest). Needs >= 5 years.

band.rationale: Bottom third of the company's own 10-year range = cheap versus itself; top third = rich versus itself.

implied_growth_pb.name: P/B-implied growth
implied_growth_pb.equation: g = (Ke x P/B - ROE) / (P/B - 1); n/m if |P/B - 1| < 0.05
implied_growth_pb.meaning: Perpetual growth implied by today's P/B for a lender/insurer (justified P/B solved for g) at its 3-year average ROE.

implied_pb_growth_minus_delivered.name: P/B-implied - delivered growth
implied_pb_growth_minus_delivered.equation: implied_growth_pb - BVPS CAGR 5y (PAT CAGR 5y if n/m)
implied_pb_growth_minus_delivered.meaning: Growth the market prices in versus the book-value compounding actually delivered over 5 years.

band.rationale: Same logic for lenders/insurers versus delivered book-value compounding.

justified_pb.name: Justified P/B
justified_pb.equation: (ROE - g) / (Ke - g); ROE = 3y avg, g = min(ROE x (1 - 3y avg payout), terminal g)
justified_pb.meaning: P/B a single-stage residual-income model supports: (ROE - g) / (Ke - g) with sustainable ROE and growth.
justified_pb.text: Justified P/B: 1.20x [informational (neutral direction)] Note: ROE 17.7%, g 6.0%, Ke 15.77%

pb_to_justified_pb.name: P/B / justified P/B
pb_to_justified_pb.meaning: Market P/B relative to what returns justify: above 1 = paying for more than current ROE supports.

band.rationale: Paying 50%+ above the P/B that sustainable ROE justifies needs ROE to rise; at or below 1.0x the price is covered by current returns.

sector.how_to_read:
Judge a bank after credit costs, not before: RoA = NII/A + fees/A - opex/A - provisions/A - tax/A, and RoE = RoA x leverage.
NIM and fees show earning power; credit cost, GNPA/NNPA and PCR show what the loan book really earns.
CRAR and CASA decide how long growth can last: fast loan growth with falling capital is the classic Indian blow-up pattern.
Read asset quality and capital before profit growth.

data_notes.text: Source file YESBANK.xlsx; sha256 a97a2aeb512bb819...; Screener template version 2.1. Only the 'Data Sheet' is read (display sheets are formulas without cached values).
Units: Rs crore. Share counts in crore (Screener 'Adjusted Equity Shares in Cr'); prices in Rs.
Data Sheet has 2 formula cell(s) without cached values (e.g. 'Number of shares'); recomputed where needed.
Blank line items are treated as zero (Screener leaves zero items blank; the P&L and balance-sheet identities hold on that basis). Blank price or share count = missing.
Financial company: other income is core (fees, treasury), so no exceptional-item estimate is made.
No material minority/associate residual: export is standalone or has no minorities.

Bank-like mapping: Sales = interest earned (NBFC: revenue from operations); Interest = interest expended; Borrowings = deposits + borrowings (NBFC: borrowings); Other Assets include advances/loans; Other Expenses include provisions & contingencies (credit costs are not separable in the export); CFO is driven by loan/deposit flows and is not an earnings-quality signal.

Capex is not in the export. Proxy = change in net block + change in CWIP + depreciation (includes acquired fixed assets and Ind AS 116 right-of-use additions; impairments and disposals understate it). FCF = CFO - capex proxy.

Per-share history is split/bonus/rights-adjusted by Screener (adjusted shares / reported shares: FY17 x5.00). EPS, BVPS, DPS and FY-end prices all use the adjusted basis, so ratios are unaffected; per-share levels are in today's share units (a unit look-ahead, not an information look-ahead).
As-of FY18: annual data after FY18, all later quarters and the export-date price are removed before standardisation; valuation uses the FY18 year-end price.
No quarterly data in export (or none on/before the as-of date).
Manual KPIs loaded: advances_cr, casa_pct, cet1_pct, crar_pct, deposits_cr, gnpa_pct, nnpa_pct, pcr_pct, provisions_cr for FY14, FY15, FY16, FY17, FY18.
36 manual KPI values: 0 verified against the primary document (Y), 36 from secondary sources (N). Provenance is in analysis.json (manual_kpis).
Manual KPI years FY14, FY15, FY16 precede the export (FY17): added as KPI-only rows (all export fields blank) so KPI trends cover them.
